description: Searches OpenAlex (CC0) for scholarly works: title, authors with institutions, year, venue, DOI, open-access PDF link, citation count, topic and abstract (max 2,000 characters). Filters: publication year range, open access only, minimum citations; sort by relevance, citations or date (citations and date search the words as one phrase). Limit max 25. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
